GRAND RAPIDS FAMILY NETWORK

The city is part of your family support system.

Parent University connects GRPS families to trusted Grand Rapids and Kent County organizations for learning, health, housing, food, child care, activities, careers and more. Start with what you need—we will help narrow the options.

ABOUT PARENT UNIVERSITY

Helping caregivers become confident partners and advocates.

OUR PURPOSE

Family learning + family support + family voice

Parent University is a community-centered way for caregivers to build knowledge, access support and participate fully in their scholar’s education.

PARENT UNIVERSITY ACCOUNT

Make Parent University yours—on any device.

An account is optional. Families can still use the entire site as a guest.

With a Parent University account, families can:
  • Keep grade/stage and topic preferences together.
  • Save resources and return to them later.
  • Continue where they left off.
  • Receive more relevant recommendations over time.
  • Use the same personalized experience across devices once production authentication is connected.
Prototype note: This test version safely demonstrates the account experience using this browser only. A production launch would connect these screens to GRPS/Parent University authentication and secure cloud storage before cross-device syncing is enabled.
